title: FAIR-bioHeaders workflow parameters
description: Add FAIR-bioHeaders metadata headers to FASTA, GFA or GFF3 files and verify them

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Give input, or metadata and sequence.

input.description: Samplesheet: CSV with the columns id,metadata,sequence. Relative paths are relative to the samplesheet.

metadata.description: Metadata file (JSON, YAML, JSON-LD or HTML microdata) for a single sequence file.

sequence.description: FASTA, GFA or GFF3 file, optionally gzip- or bgzip-compressed, for a single run.

id.description: Name of the outputs of a single run (default: the sequence file name without its extension).

outdir.description: Output directory: combine/ holds the headed files, verify/ the verification reports.
